subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Benevolent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Kind**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Benevolent"** means well-meaning and kindly. (दयालु)

 
 
• **Example: **The benevolent teacher always helped her students with their problems, no matter how big or small.
 
 
 
• **"Kind"** refers to being friendly, generous, and considerate. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example: **She was very kind to the new student, showing him around the school and introducing him to her friends.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enthusiastic** (उत्साही): Having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.

 
 
• **Example:** The enthusiastic crowd cheered loudly for their favorite team.
 
 
 
• **Mysterious** (रहस्यमय): Difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify.
 
 
• **Example:** The detective was intrigued by the mysterious disappearance of the painting.
 
 
 
• **Hostile** (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Unfriendly; antagonistic.
 
 
• **Example:** The debate between the two politicians turned hostile quickly.
